title: AOE Fire Explosion
description: fx-aoe-fire v1.0 explosion pack. Effect-only, no character. 30 frames @ 10 fps (100 ms), once, 3.0s. Cell 270×200. Sheet 1620×1000 is a 6×5 row-major grid. Origin (0.5, 0.75) is pixel anchor (135, 150), the ground center of the magic circle. Story: START glowing concentric magic circle → BLAST wide radial fireball → FADE charcoal smoke and embers. Tag AOE, fire, normal×1.2, multi-tick. The cell is already normal×1.2 versus the 225px dust baseline (270 = 225 × 1.2); play at scale 1. Visual duration is 3.0s. Multi-tick damage timing is Gameplay's call. Catalog only.

assets.note: AOE fire explosion v1.0. Effect-only (no character, no body ghost). 30 frames @ 10 fps, once (100 ms/frame, 3.0s). Cell 270×200. Sheet 1620×1000 is a 6×5 row-major grid: frame i is column i%6, row floor(i/6). Anchor (135, 150) = origin (0.5, 0.75), the ground center of the magic circle. START f0–f7 glowing concentric magic circle. BLAST f8–f16 wide spherical radial fireball (peak ~f14). FADE f17–f29 charcoal smoke and embers. Tag AOE, fire, normal×1.2, multi-tick. Cell width is already normal×1.2 versus the 225px dust baseline; play at scale 1. Spawn so the anchor sits on the ground center. The visual is a 3.0s one-shot. Multi-tick damage is Gameplay's call; the sheet does not encode hit timing. Atlas: fx-aoe-fire.json. Catalog only — Gameplay owns the Stage wire.

start.story: glowing concentric magic circle, yellow/orange rune rings flat on the ground

fade.story: burst collapses into rising charcoal smoke and embers; ground fades out
